proof_body:
by
  intro m n
  have : (m + n).choose m = (Finset.powersetCard m (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (m + n)))).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_powersetCard, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [this]
  refine Finset.card_nbij' (fun ω => Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i = true)) (fun S i => decide (i ∈ S)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro ω hω
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hω
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
    exact ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, hω⟩
  · intro S hS
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_powersetCard] at hS
    simp [hS.2]
  · intro ω _
    funext i
    cases h : ω i <;> simp [h]
  · intro S _
    ext i
    simp
target_source: ∀ m n : ℕ, (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin (m + n) → Bool => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ω i = true)).card = m)).card = (m + n).choose m
